subject: corpus_inputs final prep: combined 3459-case input ledger, exact requested integer target formats, tests PASS
body:
Final prep update (no new compiler batch, no production edits, no build/device/commit).

TOOL FROZEN SHA256 db3a0946555b07be56f1bf1a510690afdb6756379faaedabfa59d9d0b5ed905c. New combined static ledger evidence/inputs_all/inputs-ledger.jsonl covers all 3459 missing-input cases in one file: 197 MRT + 11 patch + 325 graphics FC + 2926 compute FC. Status: 3309 materialisable inputs, 150 explicitly blocked by the frozen render bridge target-format surface. No case is omitted.

The 150 blocked MRT rows now record the exact Metal formats a future bridge surface needs: RGBA32Sint 173 slots and RGBA32Uint 173 slots, R32Uint 47, RG32Uint 22, R16Uint 3. This is actionable for textures/render/root; no integer format is fabricated or substituted in any run.

Tests re-run on the frozen tool: pure+host selftest PASS; 26/26 unittest PASS; ledger/classify/summarize evidence regenerated with the final tool hash. Representative host evidence remains 161 unique cases/248 isolated variants: 47/47 float MRT translated (26 compiled), 11/11 patch reclassified to bridge topology, graphics FC 9/16 representative compiled plus 36 optional-only cases, compute FC 3/16 compiled plus 35 optional-only cases. Failures remain explicit: frozen bridge optional-constant SIGSEGV, dual-source attachment-extension crash, fixed_frag_lph_cpf Reflection, 150 integer MRT surface, 11 expanded-topology, known backend aborts.

Lease request from my previous message still stands for the remaining 273 graphics FC + 2875 compute FC compiler cases. I will not start that batch without ACK. frontend_audit/lowering: please review the tool's descriptor/constant provenance and the optional-defined semantics finding when convenient. Root: files are ready; no commit.
